description.zh: 通道账户ID；不传时移除该Agent + Channel下的所有绑定
description.en: The channel account ID. Omit this parameter to remove all bindings for the specified agent ID and channel plugin ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb unbind-polar-claw-agent --application-id pa-00000000000000 --agent-id work --channel feishu --channel-account-id default --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb UnbindPolarClawAgent --region cn-hangzhou --Channel feishu --ChannelAccountId default --AgentId work --ApplicationId 'pa-00000000000000'
